{{Quote|Good luck, your highness|Cyrus to Queen Amidala|<ref name="SWE1 game" />}}
'''Cyrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] on the peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He served during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> By the time Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] returned after her mission to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaders had complete control of the planet. Cyrus and other Security Force soldiers were captured and imprisoned in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], but before their capture they had hidden the passkeys to the palace. Cyrus held the white pass key. The [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] infiltrated [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], and [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|planned on capturing]] the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].<ref name="SWE1 game" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)}}
Amidala gained entrance to the palace and rescued one of the [[Palace Guard]]s, who told about Cyrus and the other prisoners. Amidala gained entrance to where Cyrus was being held at via a hidden door and asked for the key. Cyrus gave her the white pass key, and Amidala placed him in charge of the prisoners before she left to continue her mission. Before she left, Cyrus wished the Queen good luck.<ref name="SWE1 game" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Expandsect}}
Cyrus is a character who appears in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. It is necessary to gain access to the room where Cyrus is being held, either by a hidden door or a door guarded by a squad of [[P-series droideka/Legends|destroyer droids]]. This article assumes the player, in the guise of Queen Amidala, took the secret route. When the player reaches the room, they engage Cyrus in a series of dialogues to acquire the white passkey.
